plan.root_cause: The suggestion list items have tabindex='0', placing them in the tab order. When the list is open, pressing Tab from the city input focuses the first suggestion instead of moving to the next form field.
plan.repair_strategy: Change the tabindex of list items from '0' to '-1' in the Awesomplete ITEM function, removing them from the tab order while preserving ARIA roles and screen‑reader accessibility via aria-activedescendant.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Tab while the autocomplete list is visible will move focus to the next form field (#dietary) instead of trapping focus in the suggestion list, restoring correct tab order.
functional_risks: Talkback or other screen readers that relied on tabindex='0' for list item navigation may need to rely on aria-activedescendant; however the widget already sets this attribute when an item is highlighted, so impact is minimal.
Any custom CSS that styles :focus on list items based on tabindex may no longer apply; verify that visual focus indicators are still provided via arrow-key navigation.
verification_requirements: After typing at least two characters in the city field, the suggestion list appears.
Pressing Tab moves focus to the dietary requirements field when the list is open.
ArrowUp/ArrowDown still navigate within the suggestion list.
Enter key selects the highlighted suggestion and closes the list.
Screen readers can still announce suggestions and the selected value via the combobox's aria-activedescendant.
